stories.headline: Exclusive: How Jay-Z Pulled Off a Surprise-Filled Show During New York’s Wildest Summer
stories.dek: Summer 2026 marks the 30th anniversary of Jay-Z’s debut Reasonable Doubt. To honor it, he put on a massive concert at Yankee Stadium—complete with performances from Beyoncé, Nas, and Alicia Keys.

stories.headline: US cybersecurity agency CISA had to build its incident playbook during the incident, agency reveals
stories.dek: Independent cybersecurity journalist Brian Krebs reported in May that a security researcher with cyber firm GitGuardian alerted him to reams of exposed passwords stored in a publicly accessible GitHub repository, which an employee of a CISA contractor had uploaded.

stories.headline: Phia accused of ‘cookie stuffing,’ taking affiliate credit on purchases it didn’t earn
stories.dek: Phia, the shopping startup founded by Bill Gates’ daughter, Phoebe, and her friend Sophia Kianni is under fire for a practice known as “cookie stuffing,” which helped the product receive commissions and credit for sales it did not actually generate, per a Bloomberg investigation.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by cottonbro studio on Pexels

stories.headline: Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash
stories.dek: "Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way," the company said in a blog post. "We've heard the feedback that this feature missed the mark, so it's no longer available."
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Julio Lopez on Unsplash

stories.headline: A new app, HyperTexting, turns the open web into a scrollable social media-like feed
stories.dek: HyperTexting's new app aims to make the open web feel more like social media by turning websites, blogs, newsletters, and podcasts into a scrollable feed, while also making it easier to post to your own website.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Jonathan Kemper on Unsplash

stories.headline: EU threatens Meta with fines over addictive features on Facebook and Instagram
stories.dek: The tech giant is in breach of the Digital Services Act by focusing on features like infinite scroll, autoplay, push notifications, and the highly personalized recommendation algorithms, the European Commission said.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Julio Lopez on Pexels
